full_judgment: "Seen the report of the R.C.O. and the sketch map showing area proposed to be classified as bazar, I personally went to the locality, and personally inspected the area. The area shown in the sketch map in red attested by the R.C.O. and R.V.W. signed by me should be classified bazar and bat area for the purpose of determining' non-retainable khas land under section 20 of the State. Acquisition and Tenancy Act, The S.D.S.O. should finalise the case and the R.C.O. should correct the record accordingly and prepare compensation for the persons concerned."
